verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 documents creating team-scoped API keys for SDK and raw HTTP API access (docs-37), so it offers scoping at the team level. There is no evidence of finer-grained, permission-limited or per-agent credentials. The outbound credential-injection feature is a related but different capability and is not credited. Missing for 10: per-agent or per-sandbox keys, permission/role scoping, key expiry or revocation controls, and in-depth docs or independent corroboration.
